summary: Audited the 16 guest cases labeled pass across guest-settings-002 and render-retest-001 against inventory steps and expected outcomes. Six remain supported as full case results; ten were corrected to unverified because recorded evidence omits at least one required behavior. Existing unverified deep-capture case remains unchanged.
verification: Read docs/stabilization/PLAN.md, INVENTORY-CONTRACT.md, both run records, and corresponding reports; compared each claim to its full inventory expected criteria.
Changed only ten unsupported guest case result entries; preserved run/evidence history and all other inventory sections/cells.
Before: 16 pass, 1 unverified among 17 audited result entries. After: 6 pass, 11 unverified. Of the ten corrected: 8 in EXT-F-1003 and 2 in EXT-F-1007.
limitations: No UI, tests, builds, or product behavior were run. This is an evidence sufficiency audit, not a new runtime verification.
Case passes retained where the recorded outcome fully matched the explicit expected result; no acceptance criterion was weakened.

Three guest case expected fields mix guest checks with authenticated positive or member-denial behavior. Their original expected text is preserved; guest cold/reload negative checks remain unverified, and the cases are flagged in remaining_criteria as acceptance-spec mode-mixing defects pending an explicit mode-specific correction.
next_action: Allocate follow-up runs to the ten remaining criteria recorded per case; prioritize missing functional effect checks and the role matrix.

verdict_a_behavior_contract.finding: release.sh unit-tests check invokes Vitest with --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 (both CHECKS command variants). The test fixture matcher recognizes that exact single-worker command shape, writes the current checked-out SHA to checked-shas before responding to the fail-tests sentinel with exit 1 and 2 failed / 10 passed output. The failure run asserts nonzero exit and that checked-shas is nonempty before concluding publication was refused.

verdict_b_code_quality.finding: The failure-injection run records the SHA at the matching Vitest invocation and asserts only that checked-shas is nonempty before confirming publication refusal. The separate successful remote-race path checks at least three candidate validations and explicitly asserts the final checked SHA equals origin/main (the published SHA). Thus candidate identity is checked on the successful publication path; the failure-path assertion is narrower.

evidence: scripts/test-release-ship-path.sh pnpm stub matcher and failure assertions
